'''Triggo Binz''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] thug who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|I'm told the saboteur is a Twi'lek named Binz. I doubt he'll let himself be quietly arrested.|[[Rakir Banai]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:RB" />}}
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], former [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] [[Kitster Chanchani Banai|Kitster Banai]] attempted to improve the lives of the slaves on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. This led him to struggle against the slaver [[Drik Bandrik]].<ref name="SWG:KB">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=static|Kitster Banai|Tatooine}}</ref> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Kitster Banai tasked Triggo Binz to undermine Drik's local mining business. Unaware that his boss was a slaver, Drik's employee [[Rakir Banai]] recruited a spacer to stop Binz and prevent him to blow up the mine. The spacer tracked down the Twi'lek saboteur and killed him after a brief fight. Just before dying, Triggo Binz revealed the truth about Drik Bandrik's slaver activity, and the spacer reported this information to Rakir Banai.<ref name="SWG:RB" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:ThugTwilekMaleTemplate.jpg|250px|thumb|Possible depictions of Triggo Binz]]
Triggo Binz was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]].<ref name="SWG:RB" /> The game was shut down on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
